novel_features.name: Public catalog search without credentials
novel_features.description: Search DriveThruRPG's public product catalog by keyword while keeping JSON output agent-friendly.
novel_features.rationale: Existing downloader tools focus on owned libraries; this exposes store discovery without requiring auth.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Agents can answer store-discovery questions before asking the user for credentials.

novel_features.name: Authenticated library inventory
novel_features.description: List owned DriveThruRPG order products and file indexes using the Library App Application Key flow.
novel_features.rationale: Users need the orderProductId and file index before a reliable download can happen.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Agents can inspect owned purchases and choose the right file index without scraping website pages.

novel_features.name: Owned file downloader
novel_features.description: Prepare, poll, and save a purchased DriveThruRPG file from a single command.
novel_features.rationale: The raw API exposes separate prepare/check steps; users want one reliable download workflow.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Agents can execute the full authenticated file retrieval workflow without hand-rolling polling logic.
